answer: Give every new identity a single narrow inlet: one verified entry task that must be completed in the open before any wider rights unlock. A falcon-fast audit panel then re-checks a random sample of those entries each epoch, and every check is written to a crystal-clear public log anyone can replay. A fake identity therefore pays the full cost of real work at the inlet, risks exposure at audit, and cannot hide behind opacity, while an honest agent passes once and keeps its standing.
